title: Aggregate exposure across the frozen engine's arms and timeframes, and five exposure policies compared on the DEVELOPMENT partition, in shadow mode. Research only: no production limit, no alert change
status: REGISTERED 2026-11-28, written and committed before any of its code or any run; research only; no production change
approval: Operator, 2026-11-27 mandate, G6 (SHADOW MODE): "Measure: simultaneous open-alert count, directional exposure, combined stop-loss exposure, correlated strategy exposure, maximum potential daily loss, and session concentration. Evaluate 1-open / 3-max as a hypothesis only. Do not introduce an arbitrary position limit. No production enforcement without approval." 2026-11-28 mandate, Part 5: "Compare alternative exposure limits using historical development data ... The user's actual manual trading arrangement is strictly one open MT5 trade at a time. The G6 1-open/3-maximum proposal is a separate shadow research hypothesis and must not override the manual trading rule or become a production control." Development partition only.
forward_ledgers: measured descriptively only (exposure statistics of the recorded forward trades); no policy is compared or chosen on them
arms_and_timeframes: the frozen engine's treatment arm and arm H4 on 5m, 15m, 30m and 1h (the G5-SENS frozen runs; 5m on the development 5-minute bars from 2020-03-16). Every arm already holds one position at a time; exposure arises across arms and timeframes

measurements.concurrency: number of positions open at each 5-minute bar close: distribution, maximum, share of time with 2+ / 3+ open
measurements.direction: net and gross BUY / SELL exposure in positions and in R at risk
measurements.combined_stop: sum of open initial risk (1 R per open position) and the worst simultaneous R at risk
measurements.correlated: share of time two or more open positions share a direction; overlapping signals = entries in the same direction within 60 minutes across timeframes
measurements.session: entries and open R by session label
measurements.daily: maximum potential daily loss (the sum of R at risk of every position opened in a New York session day) and the realised daily R
measurements.streaks: longest run of consecutive losing trades in exit order
measurements.drawdown: combined maximum drawdown of cumulative net R in exit order

policies.P0_none: every trade of every arm and timeframe (the baseline)
policies.P1_one_open: at most ONE open position across all arms and timeframes: the operator's own manual rule. A signal arriving while a position is open is BLOCKED and recorded
policies.P2_one_open_three_per_day: the B11 hypothesis: one open position and at most three entries per New York session day
policies.P3_three_open: at most three open positions at once
policies.P4_one_open_per_direction: at most one open long and one open short

tie_break: signals are taken in fill-time order; at the same fill time the higher timeframe first, then treatment before H4 (fixed here, not chosen by outcome)
first_order: a policy keeps or blocks each recorded trade; the arms' own trade sequences are not re-simulated (a blocked trade does not create a new one)
comparisons: each of P1-P4 against P0 and P1 against P2: mean net R per trade and total R per day with paired day-block bootstrap 95% intervals; the blocked trades' count, mean net R and TP1-first share; maximum drawdown and the worst day
multiple_testing: 5 comparisons x 2 measures = 10 tests; Holm, and BH reported
decision: NONE. No policy is adopted for production or the alerts. The operator's one-trade-at-a-time manual rule is the operator's, not a result of this study; the 1-open / 3-max proposal stays a hypothesis whatever the result
not_done_by_design: no change to the engine, config.py, the alerts or the Pine files
no validation, holdout, 2026 or forward-data comparison
no policy beyond the five listed
outputs: research/G6_EXPOSURE_RESULTS.json and .md; the forward exposure in docs/final_audit/evidence/g6_forward_exposure_<day>.json

amendments.written: before any result of the primary run was read (the primary development run was still computing; only its per-timeframe trade counts had been logged) and before any A1 code or run
amendments.reason: The operator's 2026-11-28 mandate, Part 5, asks for the analysis 'across all strategy arms'; the original registration covered only the treatment arm and arm H4 on 5m-1h. A1 widens the scope; the original analysis stays as registered and is reported unchanged as the PRIMARY family.
amendments.arms: every live forward-test arm: treatment, control, challenger, h2, h3, h4, h5 (h6 is CLOSED under Amendment F and has no live record; it is left out and said so)
amendments.timeframes: 5m, 15m, 30m, 1h and 4h (4h on the development partition = the New York-session 4-hour resample of the 1-hour bars, sources.resample_ny_session, as production builds the 4h series' higher-timeframe context)
amendments.engine_runs: one feature computation per timeframe; engine.run in modes treatment, control and challenger on it, exactly as quantum/pipeline.py does; backtest.simulate for those three; arm_h2/h3/h4/h5.simulate on the treatment run, exactly as quantum/report.py does
amendments.tie_break: fill time, then the higher timeframe first (4h, 1h, 30m, 15m, 5m), then arm order treatment, control, challenger, h2, h3, h4, h5; fixed here
amendments.policies_and_comparisons: the same five policies and the same 5 comparisons x 2 measures, as a SECOND family of 10 tests (A1); Holm and BH within A1; BH across both families also reported
amendments.forward: descriptive only, as registered: every live ledger <tf>_<arm>.json for the arms and timeframes above, records under the current freeze key
amendments.out_of_scope_listed: alert streams and shadow records that are not positions with a fill, an exit and a net R (breakout, sweep, zone and report messages; the B9 / B15b / SETUP / CONFIRM / B31b research-forward records, whose outcome is a race label): counted and listed with the reason, not modelled as positions
